description:
**Phase A — Foundation. Deps: A1.**

Add a read-side counterpart to existing `SessionStore.append/2` (`apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/session_store.ex` is currently write-only: open/path/append/close).

`read_entries/1` streams the JSONL file and decodes each line into the typed union from A1.

Tests: round-trip both `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/fixtures/before-compaction.jsonl` and `large-session.jsonl`.
title: A2. SessionStore.read_entries/1 — streaming JSONL parser
